import copy, hashlib, json, sys
from datetime import datetime
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd
sys.path.insert(0, str(Path.cwd() / 'bench'))
import run as runner
suite = runner.load_suite()
suite['cells'] = [dict(id=f'qr-deficient-{mode}', model='ols', design='dense',
                       effects=1, regressors=65, rows=65536, weights='analytic',
                       vce='iid', outputs=False, scc=False) for mode in ['fast','low']]
suite['tiers']['m1'] = dict(cells=[c['id'] for c in suite['cells']], threads=[1,4,16], timeout_seconds=300)
runner.load_suite = lambda: copy.deepcopy(suite)
original_generate = runner.generate
def generate(cell, seed, path):
    metadata = original_generate(cell, seed, path)
    data = pd.read_stata(path, convert_categoricals=False)
    data['y'] += (0.30 / 65) * (data['x1'] - data['x65'])
    data['x65'] = data['x1']
    data.to_stata(path, write_index=False, version=114, time_stamp=datetime(2000,1,1))
    metadata.update(sha256=runner.sha256(path), recipe='Seeded dense analytic-weight design with exact x65=x1; outcome contribution adjusted to retain generating coefficients. Singular finite Gram forces QR fallback.')
    path.with_suffix('.json').write_text(json.dumps(metadata, indent=2)+'\n')
    return metadata
runner.generate = generate
original_launch = runner.launch
template = (Path.cwd()/'bench/stata_runner.do').read_text()
def launch(command, directory, timeout):
    mode = directory.parent.name.rsplit('-',1)[1]
    selected = template.replace('local controls threads(`threads\')', 'local controls threads(`threads\') memory('+mode+')')
    selected = selected.replace('file write `metadata\' "N"', 'file write `metadata\' "rank" _tab %24.17g (e(rank)) _n\n    file write `metadata\' "N"')
    custom = directory/'qr_runner.do'
    custom.write_text(selected)
    script = directory/'command.do'
    script.write_text(script.read_text().replace(str(Path.cwd()/'bench/stata_runner.do'), str(custom)))
    return original_launch(command, directory, timeout)
runner.launch = launch
runner.run(runner.arguments())
